role: Post-open solver-native mechanism audit on already opened BLASTNet Case 19. It removes anchor selection by pooling one K1 direction from every deployment-visible frame into one unordered rank-16 paired field/measurement subspace.
scientific_question: Can an anchor-free, frame-set-equivariant rank-16 subspace built only from per-frame K1 PCGLS pairs produce K16-matched and absolutely safe K14-refined fields on all 13 Case 19 rigs at 15A+15A^T per frame, when equal-cost local controls do not?

unique_primary.name: unordered_normalized_k1_pair_svd16_cached_projection_pcgls_k14
unique_primary.screen: For every frame independently run exactly one zero-start geometry-Jacobi PCGLS iteration and retain the paired field direction p_i and measurement direction q_i=A p_i.
unique_primary.normalization: Divide both p_i and q_i by the positive L2 norm of q_i so every frame contributes one equal-weight paired direction. Do not center, whiten, clip or use truth-derived weights.
unique_primary.subspace: Stack normalized q_i as Q and normalized p_i as P. Compute the thin SVD Q=U diag(s) V^T and retain exactly the first 16 singular triplets. The paired lift is B=P V_16 diag(s_16^-1), for which A B=U_16.
unique_primary.initializer: For every frame y, use x0=B U_16^T y and its cached exact projection A x0=U_16 U_16^T y, then restart the unchanged geometry-Jacobi PCGLS recurrence for exactly 14 iterations.
unique_primary.frame_set_equivariance: The complete set is unordered. Reversing or otherwise permuting frame columns must preserve the physical initializers and final fields within the frozen numerical tolerance.
unique_primary.camera_permutation: Reported camera IDs restore labeled blocks to canonical ID order before K1 screening; a joint input/geometry camera permutation must preserve physical fields and calls.

same_cost_controls.self_k1_restart_k14: Use each frame's own sealed K1 field and exact K1 projection, then restart geometry-Jacobi PCGLS for 14 iterations. Total 15A+15A^T per frame.
same_cost_controls.zero_geometry_jacobi_pcgls_k15: Run zero-start geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K15. Total 15A+15A^T per frame.
same_cost_controls.sealed_chronological_fifo16_k14: Use the componentwise formal/independent worst envelope of the sealed v244.2 dynamic pre-update FIFO16 K14 parent. Its 496A+464A^T per rig is lower than the v254 primary.
same_cost_controls.sealed_zero_pcgls_k14: Use the componentwise formal/independent worst envelope of zero-start geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K14.
same_cost_controls.sealed_zero_cgls_k14: Use the componentwise formal/independent worst envelope of zero-start unpreconditioned CGLS K14.

disclosed_nonadmissible_diagnostic.v252_fixed_midpoint_discrete_result: Both v252 implementations independently reported 429/429 absolute and matched cells for a fixed-midpoint traversal, but v252 failed frozen continuous numeric checks and remained inconclusive.
disclosed_nonadmissible_diagnostic.reason_not_a_formal_control_pass: It uses sequence index, is not frame-set equivariant, and belongs to an invalid closed execution. It remains disclosed so v254 cannot be presented as globally unique.

accuracy_contract.reference_metric: Use the componentwise maximum of sealed v244.2 formal and independent K16 metrics for absolute-reference adequacy, and the componentwise minimum as the conservative denominator for matched-accuracy ratios.

prediction_barrier.inputs_before_barrier: Only sealed observations, reported virtual geometry, K1 paired solver states and frozen PCGLS constants.

independent_method.formal: Use direct thin SVD of the 4608x33 normalized projected-direction matrix.
independent_method.independent: Use an explicit 33x33 Gram matrix, symmetric eigendecomposition, descending eigenpairs and paired field/measurement reconstruction. Do not import the formal v254 subspace module or runner.
independent_method.robust_scoring: Score formal and independent candidate arrays separately and use componentwise maxima for every discrete cell and rig decision.

decision_order: Any source, parent, prior-closure, payload, prediction-barrier, operator, paired-basis, rank, call, replay, permutation, finite, numerical-envelope or independent-recomputation failure gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE19_K1_SET_SUBSPACE_V254.
If the primary fails any robust absolute or K16-matched cell or complete-rig gate, conclude FAIL_CASE19_K1_SET_SUBSPACE_MATCHED_ACCURACY_V254 and close pooled K1 set-subspace warm starts.

If the primary passes but any admissible same-or-lower-cost control also passes, conclude POST_OPEN_K1_SET_SUBSPACE_HEADROOM_BUT_CONTROL_NOT_REJECTED_V254 and do not authorize a predictor or resource gate.

If the primary passes, admissible controls fail, but the robust K16 reference is absolutely inadequate, conclude POST_OPEN_K1_SET_SUBSPACE_HEADROOM_REFERENCE_INADEQUATE_V254 and do not claim effective call reduction.

Only primary pass, all admissible controls fail, adequate robust reference and complete independent recomputation may conclude PASS_CASE19_K1_SET_SUBSPACE_HEADROOM_V254. Case 19 remains opened development evidence and still requires a separately frozen unopened condition.
failure_action: Close unordered rank-16 normalized K1 pair pooling without changing rank, normalization, centering, solver depth, restart, SVD truncation, controls or thresholds. Do not switch to another Case 19 anchor, graph traversal, global truth-tail basis, learned frame ordering, CNN/FNO/UNO/DeepONet or GPU rental.
